hints.title: Delimiter Conversion
hints.text: Replace non-digit characters with spaces to segment consecutive digits into integer tokens.

hints.title: Leading Zero Normalization
hints.text: Normalize each integer token by stripping leading zeros so that identical numerical values match.

hints.title: Distinct Value Set
hints.text: Insert normalized string tokens into a set to count unique numeric values.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing without normalizing leading zeros fails to identify identical numbers such as 01 and 1.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear pass tokenization and set deduplication processes strings in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles strings composed entirely of zeros by normalizing them to a single 0.
